name: Grasses and their borrowed genes

citation.text: Hibdige, S. G. S., Raimondeau, P., Christin, P.-A., & Dunning, L. T. (2021). Widespread lateral gene transfer among grasses. New Phytologist, 230(6), 2474–2486.

description: The thirteen grass genomes in which Hibdige and colleagues found genes passed sideways from another lineage of grasses, with six of those lineages and a few close relatives the same genes turned up in. Wheat, maize, sorghum, millets and the C4 grass Alloteropsis are among them.
